properties.description: THIS IS AN INTERIOR REMODELING OF A BUILDING ORIGINALLY USED BY ENTERPRISE RENT-A-CAR AS A  CUSTOMER SERVICE OFFICE AND SALES CENTER.  THE BUILDING IS LOCATED WHERE SCHILLING ST, ZEMKE BLVD AND MANNHEIM COME TOGETHER.  THE CITY'S ONLINE ZONING MAP LIST THE ADDRESS AS 6400 N SCHILLING ST. AND A SIGN ON THE BUILDING SAYS "BLDG 810" THE INTERIOR WILL BE PARTLY REMODELED SO THE ENTIRE INTERIOR CAN BE USED AS A TRAINING CENTER AND OFFICES FOR THE CHICAGO DEPARTMENT OF AVIATION.THE FORMER CUSTOMER SERVICE AREA WILL BE TWO TRAINING ROOMS AND AN EXISTING CONFERENCE ROOM WILL BE DIVIDED INTO TWO NEW OFFICES. THE BREAKROOM WILL HAVE APPLIANCES, CABINETS, SINK AND COUNTERTOP REPLACED IN THE SAME LOCATIONS.  THESE REMODELED SPACES WILL HAVE NEW FLOORING, LIGHTING AND SUSPENDED CEILINGS.  THE EXISTING VESTIBULE DOORS WILL ALL BE REPLACED.  NO WORK WILL BE DONE ON THE SITE- ALL PARKING, SIDEWALKS, LIGHTING AND LANDSCAPING IS ALL EXISTING TO REMAIN WITH NO CHANGES.
